top_signals.title: Anthropic Fervor, Vanguard's 'Hot Sauce,' "ETIFs" Emerge
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Raymond James Vice President of ETF Strategy Mayuranki De, ETF.com President & Director of Research Dave Nadig, Vanguard Head of ETF Fixed Income Product Katy Righi, and BNY Global Head of ETFs Ben Slavin. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: How Ethiopia’s Gas-Car Ban Sparked an EV Boom
top_signals.summary: Ethiopia became the first country to ban imports of gasoline-powered cars in 2024. Today, its EV share outpaces the global average, but the road ahead is uncertain. Can Ethiopia’s bet on EVs pay off? (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Lula Worries Slam Brazil Markets From Real to Corporate Debt
top_signals.summary: Brazilian assets slumped on Monday, with the real touching its lowest level since April 2025, as mounting doubts over the government’s fiscal plans fueled expectations that interest rates will stay elevated for longer.
